Zechariah 11:16: Look, I am raising up a shepherd over the land: he will certainly not attend to what is failing, seek what is scattered, heal what is broken or guide what is whole. He will devour the flesh of the choice ones and wrench their ankle bones.
Zechariah 11:17: Oh, you who shepherd worthless things and have abandoned the sheep! A sword against his arms and his right eye! His arm will utterly wither, and his right eye will be completely blinded.”
Zechariah 12:1: An oracle of the Lord’s word concerning Israel. The Lord says—He who stretches out heaven, founds earth and forms a person’s spirit within him:
Zechariah 12:2: “Look, I am making Jerusalem like shaking entranceways for all the peoples around, and in Judea there will be a siege against Jerusalem.
Zechariah 12:3: On that day I will make Jerusalem a trampled stone for all the nations. Everyone trampling her will mock in mockery, and all the earth’s nations will gather against her.
Zechariah 12:4: On that day, says the Lord Almighty, I will strike every horse with bewilderment and its rider with madness. Over Judah’s house I will open My eyes, and I will strike all the peoples’ horses with blindness.
Zechariah 12:5: Judah’s commanders of thousands will say in their hearts, ‘We will find for ourselves Jerusalem’s residents in the Lord Almighty, their God.’
Zechariah 12:6: On that day I will make Judah’s commanders of thousands like a firebrand among wood and a flaming torch among stalks. They will consume all the surrounding peoples to right and left, and Jerusalem will again dwell by herself.
Zechariah 12:7: The Lord will save Judah’s dwellings as from the beginning, so that the boasting of David’s house and Jerusalem’s residents’ exaltation will not magnify itself over Judah.
Zechariah 12:8: On that day the Lord will shield Jerusalem’s residents. The weak among them will be like David’s house on that day, and David’s house like God’s house, like the angel of the Lord before them.
Zechariah 12:9: On that day I will seek to remove all the nations coming against Jerusalem.
Zechariah 12:10: I will pour upon David’s house and Jerusalem’s residents a spirit of grace and compassion. They will look toward Me because they danced in mockery, and mourn over him as over a beloved one; they will suffer grief as over a firstborn.
Zechariah 12:11: On that day mourning in Jerusalem will grow great, like mourning over a pomegranate grove cut down in a plain,
Zechariah 12:12: and the land will mourn tribe by tribe, each tribe by itself and their wives by themselves: the tribe of David’s house by itself and their wives by themselves; the tribe of Nathan’s house by itself and their wives by themselves;
Zechariah 12:13: the tribe of Levi’s house by itself and their wives by themselves; the tribe of Simeon by itself and their wives by themselves;
Zechariah 12:14: all the tribes remaining, each tribe by itself and their wives by themselves.
Zechariah 13:1: On that day every place will be opened in David’s house.
Zechariah 13:2: On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy the idols’ names from the land, and there will no longer be remembrance of them. I will remove the false prophets and the unclean spirit from the land.
Zechariah 13:3: If a person still prophesies, his father and mother who begot him will say to him, ‘You shall not live, because you spoke falsehoods in the Lord’s name.’ His father and mother who begot him will bind his feet when he prophesies.
Zechariah 13:4: On that day the prophets will be ashamed, each because of his vision when he prophesies; they will wear a hairy skin because they lied.
Zechariah 13:5: He will say, ‘I am no prophet; I am a man who works the earth, because a man begot me from my youth.’
Zechariah 13:6: I will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your hands?’ He will say, ‘The ones with which I was struck in my beloved house.’
Zechariah 13:7: Sword, awake against My shepherds, against the man who is My fellow citizen, says the Lord Almighty! Strike the shepherds and tear away the sheep; I will bring My hand against the shepherds.
Zechariah 13:8: Throughout the land, says the Lord, the two parts will be destroyed and fail, but the third will remain in it.
Zechariah 13:9: I will lead the third through fire, refine them with fire as silver is refined and test them as gold is tested. He will call on My name, and I will listen to him and say, ‘This is My people,’ and he will say, ‘The Lord is my God.’”
Zechariah 14:1: Look, days of the Lord are coming, and your spoils will be divided within you.
Zechariah 14:2: I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem for war. The city will be captured, the houses plundered and the women violated. Half the city will go into captivity, but the remnant of My people will certainly not be destroyed from the city.
Zechariah 14:3: The Lord will go out and draw up for battle among those nations, as on the day of His battle formation on a day of war.
Zechariah 14:4: On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives opposite Jerusalem to the east. The Mount of Olives will split, half of it toward the east and half toward the sea—a very great chasm; half the mountain will incline north and half south.
Zechariah 14:5: The ravine of My mountains will be blocked; the mountain ravine will be joined as far as Iasol and blocked as it was blocked in the days of the earthquake, in the days of Oziah king of Judah. The Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with Him.
Zechariah 14:6: On that day there will be no light, cold or ice.
Zechariah 14:7: It will last one day, and that day is known to the Lord, neither day nor night; toward evening there will be light.
Zechariah 14:8: On that day living water will go out from Jerusalem, half into the first sea and half into the last sea; it will be so in summer and spring.
Zechariah 14:9: The Lord will be king over all the earth. On that day the Lord will be one, and His name one,
Zechariah 14:10: encircling all the land and the wilderness from Gabe to Remmon south of Jerusalem. Rama will remain in its place, from Benjamin’s Gate to the place of the First Gate, to the Gate of Corners and to Ananeel’s Tower, to the king’s wine vats.
Zechariah 14:11: They will dwell in her; there will no longer be anything accursed, and Jerusalem will dwell confidently.
Zechariah 14:12: This will be the downfall with which the Lord will strike all the peoples who marched against Jerusalem: their flesh will melt while they stand on their feet; their eyes will flow from their sockets, and their tongue will melt in their mouth.
Zechariah 14:13: On that day great bewilderment from the Lord will be upon them. Each will seize his neighbor’s hand, and his hand will grapple with his neighbor’s hand.
Zechariah 14:14: Judah will draw up for battle in Jerusalem and gather the strength of all the surrounding peoples: gold, silver and clothing in very great abundance.
Zechariah 14:15: This will also be the downfall of horses, mules, camels, donkeys and every animal in those camps, according to this downfall.
Zechariah 14:16: Whoever remains from all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up each year to bow before the King, the Lord Almighty, and celebrate the Festival of Tent-Pitching.
Zechariah 14:17: Whoever among all the earth’s tribes does not go up to Jerusalem to bow before the King, the Lord Almighty—these will be added to those.
Zechariah 14:18: If Egypt’s tribe does not go up or come there, upon these too will be the downfall with which the Lord will strike all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tent-Pitching.
Zechariah 14:19: This will be Egypt’s sin and the sin of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tent-Pitching.
Zechariah 14:20: On that day what is upon the horse’s bridle will be holy to the Lord Almighty, and the cauldrons in the Lord’s house will be like bowls before the altar.
Zechariah 14:21: Every cauldron in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the Lord Almighty. All who sacrifice will come, take some of them and boil in them. No Canaanite will remain in the house of the Lord Almighty on that day.
